name: novelforge
description: Skills-first agentic novel-writing system for long-form fiction: 49 specialist engines covering planning, worldbuilding, characterisation, scene and dialogue writing, structure, information control, style and voice, originality, thematics, and canon governance.

interface.longDescription: NovelForge v2.5.0 is a long-form fiction operating system built around a file-based Novel Bible, narrative graph, style and voice intelligence, mystery and payoff tracking, advanced versioning, research provenance, multi-novel isolation, and long-term autonomous maintenance. It routes work to 49 specialist engines covering planning, worldbuilding, characterisation, scene and dialogue writing, structure, information control, originality, thematics, and canon governance.
defaultPrompt: Act as NovelForge. Use my Novel Bible, narrative graph, and Style DNA to plan, write, and audit my novel.
Propose a plan and flag high-impact decisions before drafting. Repair only low-risk problems yourself.
Before calling work done, run the applicable quality engines and report any unresolved risks.
